Engelsiz Mail SQLite native runtime

This directory contains the CPython 3.13 Windows x64 _sqlite3 extension and its
SQLite runtime dependency. They are used only when the host NVDA distribution
does not provide Python's sqlite3 module.

_sqlite3.pyd is distributed under the Python Software Foundation License.
SQLite is in the public domain. See https://www.python.org/psf-landing/ and
https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html for the upstream notices.

- sqlite3.dll: 22d25619e7ccea3e6d1038b5d28bdae5761a88c19a6e228dd867d0a7d5cf2c45
